articles.title: A Star Crash Glowed in X-Rays for Nearly 10 Minutes
articles.summary: Astronomers saw an X-ray flash that lasted nearly ten minutes. It may have come from two neutron stars merging and forming a magnetar, a spinning star with a huge magnetic field.

articles.title: A New Way to Spot a Tricky Quantum Link
articles.summary: Researchers in Japan demonstrated an entangled measurement that can identify a type of quantum link called a W state, using three photons. It could help future quantum technologies.

articles.title: Surprise! These Stick Insects Were Hiding in Plain Sight
articles.summary: Scientists in Australia found two new stick insect species. One has eggs with a special lid. They also gave a new name to a familiar stick insect that had been misidentified for decades.
